# resend-email-mcp

> The most complete MCP server for the Resend email API — full API coverage plus a unique debug/diagnostics layer.

resend-email-mcp is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets you control Resend
(send and manage emails, domains, contacts, broadcasts, templates, webhooks) from Claude Code,
Cursor, and Claude Desktop. Beyond CRUD, it adds diagnostic tools no other Resend MCP offers:
deliverability analysis, DNS troubleshooting, email lifecycle inspection, bounce explanation,
and account auditing.

## Tools (75 total)

### Emails
- `send_email`, `send_batch_emails`, `get_email`, `list_emails`, `update_email`, `cancel_email`
- `preview_email`: dry-run a message (resolve sender, size attachments, surface warnings) without sending
- Attachments by base64 `content`, public URL `path`, or sandboxed local `localPath`

### Attachments & received email
- `list_email_attachments`, `get_email_attachment`
- `list_received_emails`, `get_received_email`, `list_received_attachments`, `get_received_attachment`

### Domains, keys, broadcasts
- Domains: `create_domain`, `get_domain`, `list_domains`, `update_domain`, `delete_domain`, `verify_domain`
- API keys: `create_api_key`, `list_api_keys`, `delete_api_key`
- Broadcasts: `create_broadcast`, `get_broadcast`, `list_broadcasts`, `update_broadcast`, `send_broadcast`, `delete_broadcast`

### Audience
- Contacts (incl. topics/segments), contact properties, segments, templates, topics — full CRUD

### Webhooks & logs
- Webhooks: create/get/list/update/delete
- Logs: `list_logs`, `get_log`

### Debug / diagnostics (the differentiator)
- `diagnose_domain`: inspect SPF/DKIM/DMARC DNS records and report what's missing + fixes
- `analyze_deliverability`: delivery/bounce/complaint/suppressed rates with a health verdict
- `inspect_email`: full lifecycle timeline of one email
- `explain_bounce`: classify a bounce (hard/soft/block) and recommend an action
- `audit_account`: one-shot account health check
- `search_logs`: smart filtering of API logs to find failures
- `test_send`: safely simulate delivered/bounced/complained via Resend sandbox addresses

### Escape hatch
- `resend_raw`: call any Resend endpoint not yet wrapped in a dedicated tool

## Resources
- `resend://account` — domains + API keys snapshot
- `resend://domains` — sending domains with verification status

## Quick install

Add to claude_desktop_config.json or .mcp.json:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "resend": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "resend-email-mcp"],
      "env": { "RESEND_API_KEY": "re_xxxxxxxx" }
    }
  }
}
```

## Environment variables

- `RESEND_API_KEY` (required): create at https://resend.com/api-keys
- `RESEND_FROM` (optional): default sender, must be a verified domain
- `RESEND_REPLY_TO` (optional): default Reply-To
- `RESEND_READONLY` (optional): `true` blocks all mutating tools
- `RESEND_ATTACHMENTS_DIR` (optional): enables and sandboxes `localPath` attachments
- `RESEND_BASE_URL` (optional): override API base URL (https only, except localhost)

## Known limitations

- `analyze_deliverability` / `audit_account` sample the most recent 100 emails (one page), not full history.
- Disk attachments (`localPath`) are disabled unless `RESEND_ATTACHMENTS_DIR` is set.
